title: Accurate Hopper Recipe
description: Datapack adding a cheaper hopper recipe which is semi-accurate to the in-game model
body:
## Accurate Hopper Recipe
### Feature(s)
Adds a cheaper hopper recipe which is accurate to the in-game model:

![Recipe (same image file as in gallery)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/ieE9a4U4/images/10d2fdc7a1d5f272947bc73bbad10def75f2619c.png)

### Extra info
The included diagram and diagram source file describe an approximation of the hopper volume according to the wireframe in the icon.

The recipe is also accurate according to the in-game collision box.
